identity: Communication for people, apps, and agents
release: Gates 1 and 2 qualified within their recorded scope; full v0.1 remains unreleased.

gates.name: Reachable identity
gates.outcome: Local server, native Rust SDK and two independent participants exchange durable messages over UCTP/QUIC.

gates.name: Assistant chat and telephone voice
gates.outcome: Vapi chat and real Telnyx inbound/outbound telephone calls through local Connect SDK/API; live SMS explicitly deferred pending approval.

gates.name: Native media and interoperability
gates.outcome: Native media, session/capability/availability contracts, basic files and explicit cross-channel continuity.

milestones.title: Set the conversation and media contracts
milestones.outcome: Specify the six VoIP 3.0 nouns and their lifecycle/ownership in Connect before media integration. Define durable conversation context and its bounded runtime projections, invite/accept/reject/end, negotiated route capabilities and basic availability. Select media/network and minimal video profiles. Implement the contracts and compatibility experiments defined in the Gate 3 product and numbered implementation plans.
milestones.acceptance: Reviewable contracts and executable rejection fixtures: unsupported route/media, unauthorized invitation, stale/unknown availability and ambiguous context binding. Record B-001 ownership/scope and the selected network/codec profile. Demonstrate that session end, connection replacement and provider-ID changes do not erase the conversation record. Explicitly identify membership/handoff limitations; preserve Session history while treating live connection/media state as transient.
milestones.reuse: rvoip/UCTP session and capability primitives; Parley conversation semantics. Review upstream gaps before adding Connect-specific protocol extensions.

milestones.title: Carry native QUIC audio through Connect
milestones.outcome: Bridge reliable UCTP control and bidirectional QUIC datagram audio to Vapi’s WebSocket interface using rvoip media components. Bind both media legs to Participants and Connections in a Session belonging to the durable Conversation.
milestones.acceptance: Distinct client/server processes; audible two-way assistant conversation, negotiated formats, interruptions, loss/disconnect, cancellation and paired teardown. Preserve trace evidence separating QUIC and provider WebSocket legs.
milestones.reuse: rvoip QUIC media and Vapi adapter; Parley audio-host behavior. Requalify against Connect’s pinned dependency graph.

milestones.title: Prove the SIP, telephone and browser routes
milestones.outcome: Carry Telnyx SIP/PSTN audio through Connect to Vapi; add browser WebRTC participation and a named SIP endpoint. Keep the existing direct provider route available and labeled separately.
milestones.acceptance: Inbound and outbound Connect-carried telephone conversations, SIP endpoint and browser microphone/speaker audio. Test each-side hangup, hold where advertised, interruptions, provider failures and the selected NAT/TURN conditions. Preserve the Conversation/Session model across unlike transports; do not create separate application conversations for each provider leg.
milestones.reuse: rvoip SIP/WebRTC; Parley browser/SIP host; Bridgefu provider-control patterns if the chosen topology needs them. Resource creation alone is not media proof.

milestones.title: Deliver the artifact foundation
milestones.outcome: Add authorized file upload/download, conversation attachment references, integrity checks, size/retention policy and SDK methods. Provide a minimal human test surface for messages and files. This can proceed alongside media.
milestones.acceptance: One native app shares a draft; its authorized recipient retrieves matching bytes; another identity is denied. Test interrupted transfer, restart, expiry/deletion and unsupported channel behavior.
milestones.reuse: rvoip attachment model and Parley blob patterns are inputs, not a complete file service. Connect owns its access and lifecycle contract.

milestones.title: Keep the conversation coherent across channels
milestones.outcome: Prove VoIP 3.0 conversation continuity across native messages, Vapi chat and voice. Persist authorized history, artifact references and accumulated context at the Conversation level; give each runtime a bounded, attributable projection and persist its outcomes. Extend the test client to audio and basic availability.
milestones.acceptance: Share a draft and a meaningful fact in native messaging/chat; start a voice Session in that Conversation; prove the assistant can use that prior context; record the voice decision and end the Session; restart Connect and resume with a follow-up Message that uses the decision. Verify one conversation timeline, session/provider bindings, no duplicate effects and no context leakage to another conversation. Reject ambiguous context binding and do not silently contact another route after a timeout. Repeat the SMS boundary after carrier approval; live SMS remains deferred.
milestones.reuse: Parley chat/session mapping, Connect identity/journal and Thelve authority-design lessons. Call-ID correlation by itself does not prove model context transfer.

gates.name: Agent follow-through
gates.outcome: MCP and skill, Vapi tool use, one selected host and complete task-correlated agent/app follow-through.

milestones.title: Select and qualify one additional assistant host
milestones.outcome: Research the exact Meta Muse, Grokbot, OpenClaw, Codex and other candidate products. Choose one installable integration using documented interfaces. Owner deferred this research and selection to Gate 4.
milestones.acceptance: Compare installation, scoped authentication, conversation/task binding, incoming reply delivery and continuation. Record tested versions and automatic, bounded-wait or explicit-resume behavior. Name one winner with evidence; do not imply all candidates are supported.
milestones.reuse: Parley worker/pending-command patterns; Thelve managed-MCP design. Verify current host interfaces during this milestone.

milestones.title: Ship tools and a useful skill
milestones.outcome: Expose discoverable Connect MCP tools backed by the same public operations and credentials. Package the workflow skill and JSON CLI instructions. Configure Vapi to consume the tools in both chat and voice.
milestones.acceptance: Installed tools resolve, message, share a file, read history, wait for events and control supported sessions. Vapi makes an authorized tool call in chat and a live voice session; identity, call/chat, conversation and tool results correlate. Denials and retries match SDK behavior.
milestones.reuse: Thelve Streamable HTTP MCP patterns; existing SDK/CLI; Parley tool-correlation lessons. A provider-specific tool callback is not automatically an MCP endpoint.

milestones.title: Complete the agent and app follow-through journeys
milestones.outcome: The selected assistant shares a draft, asks a human, receives the reply and continues the original task. The review app both initiates and answers independently initiated requests through public interfaces.
milestones.acceptance: Install without user-written glue. Restart/resume, deduplicate replies/business effects, reject unauthorized actions and demonstrate the declared host wake/resume mode. Prove both entry points; a successful send alone does not pass.
milestones.reuse: Connect durable inbox/receipts and the existing independent app example; host adapter maintains task binding. Phone/SMS journey additionally requires the SMS lane.

gates.name: Downloadable v0.1
gates.outcome: Video, connector/protocol conformance, first-run setup, measured end-to-end acceptance and published v0.1.

milestones.title: Qualify the agreed video experience
milestones.outcome: Implement the minimal two-party video profile selected in G3-A, including public SDK/session behavior and the human reference client. Files and video remain v0.1 commitments.
milestones.acceptance: Visible video and audio between distinct clients on every advertised video path; negotiation, unsupported-profile response, access, interruption and teardown. Publish the actual topology/codecs; do not imply every provider supports video.
milestones.reuse: rvoip VP8/H.264/WebRTC/QUIC primitives and tests; requalify the exact selected Connect path.

milestones.title: Finish the contributor and protocol extension kit
milestones.outcome: Extend the existing storage-independent connector API with a capability/configuration manifest, lifecycle guidance, template and shared contract harness. Publish the interoperable wire profile and conformance materials.
milestones.acceptance: An independent contributor adds a fixture connector without changing core conversation/routing logic; explicit composition registration is allowed. A separately implemented wire client—not just the same Rust helper—negotiates and exchanges permitted requests/events using the published specification.
milestones.reuse: Current connect-connector-api; Bridgefu provider/recipe boundaries; Parley connector guidance. No marketplace or automatic third-party code loading is required.
milestones.experiment: Connector portion of E8; independent conformance

milestones.title: Make first-run setup usable and explicit
milestones.outcome: Finish resource selection/change preview, protected credential storage, human-contact ownership checks, inbound/outbound readiness diagnostics and interruption-safe setup. Define supported endpoint/NAT/ingress configuration without introducing a hosted service requirement.
milestones.acceptance: A new developer installs and runs the native demo with no account; with ready accounts, chooses resources and completes authorized provider setup. Invalid keys, unreachable callbacks and unready SMS yield specific next actions. Measure setup time after install; do not claim ten minutes before measurement.
milestones.reuse: Existing Connect provisioning/checkpoints; Parley resource handling and Thelve durable intent patterns. Confirm provenance/licensing before any additional extraction.

milestones.title: Run the complete product acceptance matrix
milestones.outcome: Qualify files, messages, voice and video through the public SDK and reference client; rerun both agent and app journeys across declared interfaces. Publish measured limits and recovery behavior.
milestones.acceptance: Fresh-user walkthroughs, cross-channel continuity, independent protocol client, SDK/MCP/CLI parity, credential revocation, file access/retention, restart/replay, unknown provider outcomes and network-loss/load tests. Publish supported OS/runtime, topology, concurrency, latency/loss and retention limits with evidence.
milestones.reuse: Reuse the existing local/package/recovery harness; add the missing media, artifact, host and live-provider evidence. Local Gate 1/2 qualification is a baseline, not this release test.

milestones.title: Publish a reproducible developer release
milestones.outcome: Prepare versioned server/SDK distributions, examples, tool/skill installation, source/dependency notices, specification licensing, compatibility matrix and release notes matching the tested capabilities.
milestones.acceptance: A reviewer outside the development workspace installs the candidate, completes both supported journeys, upgrades/restores safely and follows the connector guide. Release artifacts and documentation agree. Owner reviews before publication.
milestones.reuse: Current unpublished macOS arm64 packaging and source hashes; broader platforms require their own qualification. Existing local upstream patches remain explicit until replaced and requalified.

planning_gaps: Gate 3 has passed its 21-phase local qualification and installed-candidate checks; required human-audibility, answered/inbound PSTN and interactive browser proofs remain open. Gate 4–5 detailed plans remain unwritten.
Six Gate 3 directions are accepted and implemented locally; live route and candidate qualification must close without weakening their acceptance criteria.
Additional assistant selection/research is deferred to G4-A.
Carrier approval gates the deferred live SMS lane and full v0.1 release.
local_patches: Accepted for now; source-lock digests verified
planning_status: Gates 1–3 qualified within recorded scope. Gate 4 and Gate 5 retain their planned work; SMS remains externally deferred.
sequencing_rule: Keep gates 1–5 and their evidence IDs. Deliver basic files before Gate 4 artifact/task continuation. Design video early and qualify it in Gate 5. SMS is a parallel deferred qualification lane and a full v0.1 release blocker.

parallel_lanes.title: Return deferred SMS to live qualification
parallel_lanes.trigger: Provider/carrier approval, eligible number assignment, consented test handset and verified reachable callback endpoint
parallel_lanes.acceptance: Send and receive real SMS; verify a signed provider callback, message/delivery correlation, second-turn context and assistant-initiated summary/reply through authorized tools. Keep uncertain sends from being duplicated.
parallel_lanes.note: Gate 2 retains its owner-approved closure scope. SMS is not waived from full v0.1 and need not block independent media/agent development.

decisions.title: Availability and the scope of B-001
decisions.decision: Basic presence with a small optional preference override; available, unavailable and unknown with freshness/expiry. Keep schedules, full registries and automatic channel fallback in the backlog. No per-action permission console.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Define the wire fields, update authority, freshness durations and the bounded override semantics in G3-A; prove in G3-E.

decisions.title: Session, voice, video and network profiles
decisions.decision: Connect-carried two-party sessions over native UCTP/QUIC, Telnyx SIP/PSTN and browser WebRTC. Use invite/accept/reject/active/end-or-failure semantics; agents may auto-accept under their configured authority. Select the minimal video profile now for Gate 5 delivery.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Finalize codec set, media topology, network/NAT/TURN conditions and measurable thresholds with the first rvoip/Vapi compatibility experiment.

decisions.title: Context-transfer and ambiguous-reply policy
decisions.decision: VoIP 3.0 continuity is a core architectural requirement. Retained history and accumulated context belong to the Conversation; assistant runtimes receive explicit authorized bounded projections. Session end or transport change does not close or reset the Conversation. Never infer continuity from matching IDs alone. Persistent is the default; only explicit developer/application intent creates a new conversation.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Specify context items, provenance, versioning/watermarks, provider delivery acknowledgments, retention and ambiguous-caller behavior. Prove useful context in both directions across chat/voice, including restart.

decisions.title: Artifact lifecycle and channel representation
decisions.decision: Connect-managed local files behind a storage interface. Conversation-based metadata/access and reliable byte transfer; a native UCTP/QUIC path with an explicit HTTP option where needed. Deliver basic files in Gate 3 before the Gate 4 artifact workflow.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Define upload/download profile, limits, integrity, resume, retention/deletion and protected-link rules. File bytes do not use unreliable media datagrams.

decisions.title: Additional assistant and reply-delivery mode
decisions.decision: Additional assistant selection and delivery-mode research are deferred to G4-A. Vapi remains required. No additional host is selected or qualified.

decisions.title: Reachable ingress, secret storage and contact verification
decisions.decision: Keep the server local. Use explicitly configured development ingress for live provider tests; qualify HTTP callback and SIP/media reachability separately. Keep environment-variable credentials initially.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Choose the supported ingress strategy, protected persistent secret handling and contact ownership checks; finish usable setup in G5-C. This decision does not authorize a remote deployment.

decisions.title: Published compatibility and extension surface
decisions.decision: Reuse UCTP/rvoip interfaces first. Connect owns durable application policy; general protocol/media improvements should go upstream. Explicit pinned local patches remain acceptable. Incompatible wire changes require a new negotiated profile.
decisions.engineering_follow_up: Map the six VoIP 3.0 nouns to current APIs and persistence before adding parallel abstractions. Complete conformance, capability manifests and source/specification distribution details in G5-B/E.

principle.name: VoIP 3.0 conversation continuity
principle.source_status: Conceptual working draft; not evidence of complete rvoip/Connect implementation or a replacement wire specification.
principle.core: Conversation is the durable home for communication history and accumulated context. Sessions, Messages, Participants, Connections and Streams retain distinct responsibilities; transport/provider identifiers are bindings, not the conversation identity.
principle.context_policy: Persist conversation history and context according to declared retention/access policy. Supply authorized bounded projections to assistant runtimes, with source references, version/watermark and delivery outcome. A summary is derived context, not a replacement for retained source history. Context unavailable at a provider boundary must be explicit.
principle.gate_3_proof: Share a draft and a meaningful fact in native messaging/chat; start a voice Session in that Conversation; prove the assistant can use that prior context; record the voice decision and end the Session; restart Connect and resume with a follow-up Message that uses the decision. Verify one conversation timeline, session/provider bindings, no duplicate effects and no context leakage to another conversation. Reject ambiguous context binding and do not silently contact another route after a timeout. Repeat the SMS boundary after carrier approval; live SMS remains deferred.
principle.scope_boundary: The model must represent human/AI kinds, conversation roles and connection changes without losing conversation context. G3-A records gaps in current immutable membership and plans the minimum lifecycle contract; this does not declare live human handoff, multiparty mixing or cross-device transfer already implemented.
principle.lifetime_policy: Connect defaults to persistent conversations. New sessions, provider legs, connections and bounded runtime context views reuse the existing cid. Only explicit developer/application intent creates a new conversation; unresolved inbound binding is not an automatic split or merge.
